title: Value of information at ₫10
question: How many survey queries are worth buying at ₫10 (vs ₫5), chosen by information gain or at random?
player: BayesPlanner(num_queries=k, survey_budget=k×price, stop_entropy=None, min_gain_per_coin=None, round_query_gain=None, device=cuda:2); rule 'random' = RandomQueryPlanner (uniform pair + region)

metric_definitions.expected: deterministic expected vote share E = mean_i P_i at the election (spec §5)
metric_definitions.posterior.*: belief over σ at the start of round 1 (survey answers + round-1 free statistic + round-1 poll): p_true_sigma = posterior mass on the true σ; map_correct = MAP σ equals the true σ in all 4 regions; entropy_sigma in nats (prior log 360 = 5.886)
metric_definitions.static_share_anticipated: expected share of the committed manifesto on the anticipated TRUE electorate (social dynamics only, no campaign) — manifesto quality
metric_definitions.oracle_static_share: the same for the ORACLE manifesto (true electorate; reference, not a player)
metric_definitions.verdicts_by_round: fraction of games where the property holds at decision point t (16 poll-consistent worlds of 1,600 voters, library plan set Π_t): guaranteed = ∃π∀w win, possible = ∃π∃w, knows_win_exists = ∀w∃π, inevitable_defeat = ∀π∀w ¬win, truth_possible = ∃π winning in the TRUE world
metric_definitions.delta_vs_k0: paired mean E(k) − E(0) with t-CI and Wilcoxon p; per_coin divides by the query spend k×price
metric_definitions.marginal_vs_prev_k: paired mean E(k) − E(previous k on the grid); marginal_per_query divides by the number of extra queries
metric_definitions.net loss: a further question is a net loss when the marginal ΔE is negative (the money buys fewer workers/media than the information is worth)

tests.holm_note: Holm within each family and metric (E: Wilcoxon signed-rank; victory: exact McNemar)

deviations: Budget fix applied as planned: survey_budget = k × price and num_queries = k per arm (recorded in arms.*).
No in-round queries (round_query_gain=None) in every arm, as in the v2 info-sufficiency design, so the survey is the only paid information.
The ₫5 comparison uses both selection rules (11 arms), like ₫10.
Games are played one at a time (sequential decisions); the GPU batches worlds × plans × voters inside each decision (8 planner worlds, ≤ 20+ candidate plans, 16 logic worlds per round), not games.
